GameplayEvent Rules11 sections
How to Play

◆ In Pirate Chess, guilds will compete on the board to earn the most points. When the event starts, the process is as follows.: ※Grouping Stage: Monday 00:00 --- Wednesday 24:00 ※Preparation: Thursday 00:00 --- Friday 12:00 ※The preliminaries and semifinals will take place on Friday, Saturday, with the time being daily from 12:00 --- 22:00. ※The finals will take place on Sunday, with the time being daily from 12:00 --- 21:59. ※Before the end of the grouping stage, the guild must have Transcenders who have logged into the game in order to participate. ※During the last 15 minutes of the Preparation Phase, Transcenders who newly join a guild will not be eligible to participate. Transcenders must log into the game and join a guild before this time to qualify.

◆ Resource Points are a special type of board squares. Occupying Resource Points and maintaining a connection between them and the flagship earns points.

Tournament System

◆ Guilds will be grouped according to their total Power. The top 16 guilds will participate in the Champion Group, while every other 16 can play in Casual Groups.

◆ A maximum of 16 guilds can compete per match.

◆ The tournament is divided into three stages: preliminary, semi-final, and final.

◆ The board positioning and score results from each stage will be retained in the next stage.

◆ The top 8 in the preliminary can advance to the semi-finals, and the top 4 in the semi-finals can advance to the finals.

Board Squares Occupation

◆ Each guild starts from a Flagship square on the game board, which cannot be occupied by other guilds.

◆ Players need to deploy fellows to occupy other board squares.

◆ If it's possible to establish a route between two squares occupied by your guild, a Connection will be created. All the squares on the Connection will belong to your guild.

◆ You can only occupy squares adjacent to other squares in the path connected from the Flagship.

Resource Points

◆ A Resource Point is another type of square on the game board, which is guarded by monsters.

◆ Occupy Resource Points and maintain a connection between them and the flagship to earn points.

Points

◆ The guild that first occupies a Resource Point will receive a one-time points bonus.

◆ Guilds maintaining a connection between a Resource Point and the Flagship will get "timed points" every 15 minutes.

◆ At the end of the preliminaries, semi-finals, and finals, "tally points" will be calculated. Guilds maintaining a connection between a Resource Point and the Flagship will also earn this type of points.

Mermaid Island

◆ There are 2 Mermaid Islands on the board, guarded by monsters.

◆ After occupying a Mermaid Island, the power of fellows guarding the board squares connected to the Mermaid Island will improve.

◆ If a Mermaid Island is connected to your guild's flagship, the power of standby fellows will improve.

Occupation and Guarding

◆ Fellows deployed during an attack will occupy the board squares on which they defeat an opponent.

◆ Fellows can be deployed to guard board squares already occupied by your guild.

◆ Fellows defeated while guarding a square will enter a standby state.

Action Points

◆ At specific times during the match, fellows' Action Point will be restored; at this time, all fellows whose Action Point is not at max will recover 1 Action Point.

◆ Moving fellows for occupation, guarding, or withdrawal will consume Action Point.

◆ Upon withdrawal, fellows will enter a standby mode, and their power will be restored to 100%.

Siege

◆ Cutting off the connection between an opponent's occupied square and their flagship is called sieging.

◆ When a resource point is sieged, the occupier will not be able to earn points from it.

◆ When a board square is sieged, the fellows occupying that square will not be able to move.

◆ The power of fellows standing on sieged squares will gradually decrease over time.

Rewards

◆ The Champion Group participants will receive rewards based on the rankings. The ranking is sorted from highest to lowest based on the points in the event. If the points are the same, the ranking is sorted based on the tally points from highest to lowest. If both the points and tally points are the same, the ranking is sorted based on the guild's total power, from highest to lowest.

◆ The first-place guild in the Champion Group will receive a grand prize, which needs to be allocated by the Guild Leader.

◆ A portion of the grand prize can only be given to guild members who dealt some damage in the game.

Change Artifact

◆ During Pirate Chess, the power of guarding fellows will adjust accordingly when replacing Artifacts.

◆ During the preliminary, semi-final, and final rounds, each player is limited to replacing/unequipping Artifacts 3 times daily.

Participate in Pirate Chess to win the Figure [Azure Commander]!

Event RestrictionDuring the Gameplay Period, qualified members cannot leave the Guild if the Guild has not been eliminated.
Duration7 daysDefault finish hour22:00UnlockPlayer Lv. 9

Core Rewards

Figure [King of Pirates]Player Costume · King of the PiratesFigure [Azure Commander]Player Costume · Azure Commander
GameplayEvent Rules11 sections
How to Play

◆ In Pirate Chess, guilds will compete on the board to earn the most points. When the event starts, the process is as follows.: ※Grouping Stage: Monday 00:00 --- Wednesday 24:00 ※Preparation: Thursday 00:00 --- Friday 12:00 ※The preliminaries and semifinals will take place on Friday, Saturday, with the time being daily from 12:00 --- 22:00. ※The finals will take place on Sunday, with the time being daily from 12:00 --- 21:59. ※Before the end of the grouping stage, the guild must have Transcenders who have logged into the game in order to participate. ※During the last 15 minutes of the Preparation Phase, Transcenders who newly join a guild will not be eligible to participate. Transcenders must log into the game and join a guild before this time to qualify.

◆ Resource Points are a special type of board squares. Occupying Resource Points and maintaining a connection between them and the flagship earns points.

Tournament System

◆ Guilds will be grouped according to their total Power. The top 16 guilds will participate in the Champion Group, while every other 16 can play in Casual Groups.

◆ A maximum of 16 guilds can compete per match.

◆ The tournament is divided into three stages: preliminary, semi-final, and final.

◆ The board positioning and score results from each stage will be retained in the next stage.

◆ The top 8 in the preliminary can advance to the semi-finals, and the top 4 in the semi-finals can advance to the finals.

Board Squares Occupation

◆ Each guild starts from a Flagship square on the game board, which cannot be occupied by other guilds.

◆ Players need to deploy fellows to occupy other board squares.

◆ If it's possible to establish a route between two squares occupied by your guild, a Connection will be created. All the squares on the Connection will belong to your guild.

◆ You can only occupy squares adjacent to other squares in the path connected from the Flagship.

Resource Points

◆ A Resource Point is another type of square on the game board, which is guarded by monsters.

◆ Occupy Resource Points and maintain a connection between them and the flagship to earn points.

Points

◆ The guild that first occupies a Resource Point will receive a one-time points bonus.

◆ Guilds maintaining a connection between a Resource Point and the Flagship will get "timed points" every 15 minutes.

◆ At the end of the preliminaries, semi-finals, and finals, "tally points" will be calculated. Guilds maintaining a connection between a Resource Point and the Flagship will also earn this type of points.

Mermaid Island

◆ There are 2 Mermaid Islands on the board, guarded by monsters.

◆ After occupying a Mermaid Island, the power of fellows guarding the board squares connected to the Mermaid Island will improve.

◆ If a Mermaid Island is connected to your guild's flagship, the power of standby fellows will improve.

Occupation and Guarding

◆ Fellows deployed during an attack will occupy the board squares on which they defeat an opponent.

◆ Fellows can be deployed to guard board squares already occupied by your guild.

◆ Fellows defeated while guarding a square will enter a standby state.

Action Points

◆ At specific times during the match, fellows' Action Point will be restored; at this time, all fellows whose Action Point is not at max will recover 1 Action Point.

◆ Moving fellows for occupation, guarding, or withdrawal will consume Action Point.

◆ Upon withdrawal, fellows will enter a standby mode, and their power will be restored to 100%.

Siege

◆ Cutting off the connection between an opponent's occupied square and their flagship is called sieging.

◆ When a resource point is sieged, the occupier will not be able to earn points from it.

◆ When a board square is sieged, the fellows occupying that square will not be able to move.

◆ The power of fellows standing on sieged squares will gradually decrease over time.

Rewards

◆ The Champion Group participants will receive rewards based on the rankings. The ranking is sorted from highest to lowest based on the points in the event. If the points are the same, the ranking is sorted based on the tally points from highest to lowest. If both the points and tally points are the same, the ranking is sorted based on the guild's total power, from highest to lowest.

◆ The first-place guild in the Champion Group will receive a grand prize, which needs to be allocated by the Guild Leader.

◆ A portion of the grand prize can only be given to guild members who dealt some damage in the game.

Change Artifact

◆ During Pirate Chess, the power of guarding fellows will adjust accordingly when replacing Artifacts.

◆ During the preliminary, semi-final, and final rounds, each player is limited to replacing/unequipping Artifacts 3 times daily.

GameplayEvent Rules11 sections
Event Rules

◆ In Pirate Chess, guilds will compete on the board to earn the most points. When the event starts, the process is as follows.: ※Grouping Stage: Monday 00:00 --- Wednesday 24:00 ※Preparation: Thursday 00:00 --- Friday 12:00 ※The preliminaries and semifinals will take place on Friday, Saturday, with the time being daily from 12:00 --- 22:00. ※The finals will take place on Sunday, with the time being daily from 12:00 --- 21:59. ※Before the end of the grouping stage, the guild must have Transcenders who have logged into the game in order to participate. ※During the last 15 minutes of the Preparation Phase, Transcenders who newly join a guild will not be eligible to participate. Transcenders must log into the game and join a guild before this time to qualify.

◆ Resource Points are a special type of board squares. Occupying Resource Points and maintaining a connection between them and the flagship earns points.

Tournament System

◆ Guilds will be grouped according to their total Power. The top 16 guilds will participate in the Champion Group, while every other 16 can play in Casual Groups.

◆ A maximum of 16 guilds can compete per match.

◆ The tournament is divided into three stages: preliminary, semi-final, and final.

◆ The board positioning and score results from each stage will be retained in the next stage.

◆ The top 8 in the preliminary can advance to the semi-finals, and the top 4 in the semi-finals can advance to the finals.

Board Squares Occupation

◆ Each guild starts from a Flagship square on the game board, which cannot be occupied by other guilds.

◆ Players need to deploy fellows to occupy other board squares.

◆ If it's possible to establish a route between two squares occupied by your guild, a Connection will be created. All the squares on the Connection will belong to your guild.

◆ You can only occupy squares adjacent to other squares in the path connected from the Flagship.

Resource Points

◆ A Resource Point is another type of square on the game board, which is guarded by monsters.

◆ Occupy Resource Points and maintain a connection between them and the flagship to earn points.

Points

◆ The guild that first occupies a Resource Point will receive a one-time points bonus.

◆ Guilds maintaining a connection between a Resource Point and the Flagship will get "timed points" every 10 minutes.

◆ At the end of the preliminaries, semi-finals, and finals, "tally points" will be calculated. Guilds maintaining a connection between a Resource Point and the Flagship will also earn this type of points.

Mermaid Island

◆ There are 2 Mermaid Islands on the board, guarded by monsters.

◆ After occupying a Mermaid Island, the power of fellows guarding the board squares connected to the Mermaid Island will improve.

◆ If a Mermaid Island is connected to your guild's flagship, the power of standby fellows will improve.

Occupation and Guarding

◆ Fellows deployed during an attack will occupy the board squares on which they defeat an opponent.

◆ Fellows can be deployed to guard board squares already occupied by your guild.

◆ Fellows defeated while guarding a square will enter a standby state.

Action Points

◆ During specific timings in the competition period, Action Points will be restored once. At this time, all fellows will recover 2 Action Points, but this cannot exceed the Action Point limit.

◆ Moving fellows for occupation, guarding, or withdrawal will consume Action Point.

◆ Upon withdrawal, fellows will enter a standby mode, and their power will be restored to 100%.

Siege

◆ Cutting off the connection between an opponent's occupied square and their flagship is called sieging.

◆ When a resource point is sieged, the occupier will not be able to earn points from it.

◆ When a board square is sieged, the fellows occupying that square will not be able to move.

◆ The power of fellows standing on sieged squares will gradually decrease over time.

Rewards

◆ The Champion Group participants will receive rewards based on the rankings. The ranking is sorted from highest to lowest based on the points in the event. If the points are the same, the ranking is sorted based on the tally points from highest to lowest. If both the points and tally points are the same, the ranking is sorted based on the guild's total power, from highest to lowest.

◆ The first-place guild in the Champion Group will receive a grand prize, which needs to be allocated by the Guild Leader.

◆ A portion of the grand prize can only be given to guild members who dealt some damage in the game.

Change Artifact

◆ During Pirate Chess, the power of guarding fellows will adjust accordingly when replacing Artifacts.

◆ During the preliminary, semi-final, and final rounds, each player is limited to replacing/unequipping Artifacts 3 times daily.

Phase 2Pirate ChessPirateChess_02_2Hour

Participate in Pirate Chess to win the Figure [Azure Commander]!

Event RestrictionDuring the Gameplay Period, qualified members cannot leave the Guild if the Guild has not been eliminated.
Duration7 daysDefault finish hour21:00UnlockPlayer Lv. 9

Core Rewards

Figure [King of Pirates]Player Costume · King of the PiratesFigure [Azure Commander]Player Costume · Azure Commander
GameplayEvent Rules11 sections
How to Play

◆ In Pirate Chess, guilds will compete on the board to earn the most points. When the event starts, the process is as follows.: ※Grouping Stage: Monday 00:00 --- Wednesday 24:00 ※Preparation: Thursday 00:00 --- Friday 12:00 ※The preliminaries and semifinals will take place on Friday, Saturday, with the time being daily from 12:00 --- 22:00. ※The finals will take place on Sunday, with the time being daily from 12:00 --- 21:59. ※Before the end of the grouping stage, the guild must have Transcenders who have logged into the game in order to participate. ※During the last 15 minutes of the Preparation Phase, Transcenders who newly join a guild will not be eligible to participate. Transcenders must log into the game and join a guild before this time to qualify.

◆ Resource Points are a special type of board squares. Occupying Resource Points and maintaining a connection between them and the flagship earns points.

Tournament System

◆ Guilds will be grouped according to their total Power. The top 16 guilds will participate in the Champion Group, while every other 16 can play in Casual Groups.

◆ A maximum of 16 guilds can compete per match.

◆ The tournament is divided into three stages: preliminary, semi-final, and final.

◆ The board positioning and score results from each stage will be retained in the next stage.

◆ The top 8 in the preliminary can advance to the semi-finals, and the top 4 in the semi-finals can advance to the finals.

Board Squares Occupation

◆ Each guild starts from a Flagship square on the game board, which cannot be occupied by other guilds.

◆ Players need to deploy fellows to occupy other board squares.

◆ If it's possible to establish a route between two squares occupied by your guild, a Connection will be created. All the squares on the Connection will belong to your guild.

◆ You can only occupy squares adjacent to other squares in the path connected from the Flagship.

Resource Points

◆ A Resource Point is another type of square on the game board, which is guarded by monsters.

◆ Occupy Resource Points and maintain a connection between them and the flagship to earn points.

Points

◆ The guild that first occupies a Resource Point will receive a one-time points bonus.

◆ Guilds maintaining a connection between a Resource Point and the Flagship will get "timed points" every 15 minutes.

◆ At the end of the preliminaries, semi-finals, and finals, "tally points" will be calculated. Guilds maintaining a connection between a Resource Point and the Flagship will also earn this type of points.

Mermaid Island

◆ There are 2 Mermaid Islands on the board, guarded by monsters.

◆ After occupying a Mermaid Island, the power of fellows guarding the board squares connected to the Mermaid Island will improve.

◆ If a Mermaid Island is connected to your guild's flagship, the power of standby fellows will improve.

Occupation and Guarding

◆ Fellows deployed during an attack will occupy the board squares on which they defeat an opponent.

◆ Fellows can be deployed to guard board squares already occupied by your guild.

◆ Fellows defeated while guarding a square will enter a standby state.

Action Points

◆ At specific times during the match, fellows' Action Point will be restored; at this time, all fellows whose Action Point is not at max will recover 1 Action Point.

◆ Moving fellows for occupation, guarding, or withdrawal will consume Action Point.

◆ Upon withdrawal, fellows will enter a standby mode, and their power will be restored to 100%.

Siege

◆ Cutting off the connection between an opponent's occupied square and their flagship is called sieging.

◆ When a resource point is sieged, the occupier will not be able to earn points from it.

◆ When a board square is sieged, the fellows occupying that square will not be able to move.

◆ The power of fellows standing on sieged squares will gradually decrease over time.

Rewards

◆ The Champion Group participants will receive rewards based on the rankings. The ranking is sorted from highest to lowest based on the points in the event. If the points are the same, the ranking is sorted based on the tally points from highest to lowest. If both the points and tally points are the same, the ranking is sorted based on the guild's total power, from highest to lowest.

◆ The first-place guild in the Champion Group will receive a grand prize, which needs to be allocated by the Guild Leader.

◆ A portion of the grand prize can only be given to guild members who dealt some damage in the game.

Change Artifact

◆ During Pirate Chess, the power of guarding fellows will adjust accordingly when replacing Artifacts.

◆ During the preliminary, semi-final, and final rounds, each player is limited to replacing/unequipping Artifacts 3 times daily.
